people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here.” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
translations.bsb: The people of Jebus said to David, “You will never get in here.” Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
translations.kjv: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
translations.asv: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come in hither. Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion; the same is the city of David.
